# Operating model: Committee sheet

Format: 1
ID: sheet-committees

## Purpose

A small **test** sheet with a committee.

## Key messages

- Decide together.
- Test everything.

## Parties

| Party | Summary |
|---|---|
| Alpha Ltd | The client side. |
| Beta Inc | The solution side. |

## Roles

| Role | Party | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| Account lead | Alpha Ltd | Owns the client. |
| Bid manager | Alpha Ltd | Runs the bid. |
| Delivery manager | Alpha Ltd | Delivers the work. |
| Partner manager | Beta Inc | Looks after the partnership. |
| Solution architect | Beta Inc | Designs the solution. |

## Committees

| Committee | Members | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| Bid board | Account lead (A); Partner manager (A); Solution architect (C) | Decides together whether to bid. |

## Workstreams

| Workstream | Summary | Parties | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| Main work | The only workstream. | Alpha Ltd; Beta Inc | Detailed |

## Process: Main flow

Workstream: Main work

| # | Step | Owner | Next |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Capture the lead | Account lead | |
| 2 | Go or no-go | bid board | Go: 3; No go: 4 |
| 3 | Scope the work | Solution architect | End |
| 4 | Decline politely | Account lead | End |
